note: The budget hotels shortlist for scripts/sample-hotel-rates.mjs --set=budget. Every hotel named by 4+ independent sources in data/evidence.json byTopic['hotels-budget'] on 14 Sep 2026, less the formats this guide signposts instead of ranking (hostels, Zedwell, capsules, aparthotels, university rooms) and the brand-only '(brand)' records. Branches were confirmed against the source records in data/consensus/hotels-budget.json and the address the booking page shows. slug reuses the src/data/hotels.json slug where the sheet already has the hotel (inSheet: true), so 'is this slug rate-sampled' works for sheet rows. engine is where the price is read: Hotels.com wherever it lists the property; premierinn.com for Premier Inn and hub by Premier Inn, which do not sell through Hotels.com. match must appear in the booking page's own heading (letters and digits only, case ignored). A property that cannot be priced keeps its row with status and statusNote, and the report lists it.
rule: Budget means a typical sampled night UNDER £150 (Rob, 14 Sep 2026, data/topics/hotels-budget.json openVenueQuestions). A hotel whose median night is over the line drops out even if sources call it cheap.

properties.name: The Corner London City
properties.branch: One property: 42 Adler Street, Aldgate. Renamed from Qbic Hotel London City (consensus closuresAndRenames); The Travel Hack still lists it as Qbic.

properties.name: The Pilgrm
properties.branch: One property: 25 London Street, Paddington. Evening Standard spells it 'The Pilgrim'.

properties.name: citizenM London Bankside

properties.name: The Z Hotel Shoreditch

properties.name: The Z Hotel Strand
properties.branch: Named as Strand by all seven (Holiday Expert, 22places, Budget Savvy Travelers 'The Z Hotel Strand'). Distinct from Z Trafalgar and Z Covent Garden, which sources name separately.

properties.name: Premier Inn London County Hall

properties.name: The Z Hotel Soho
properties.branch: Named as Soho by all six (Time Out and Visit London 'Z Soho'). 17 Moor Street per the sheet.

properties.name: Motel One London-Tower Hill

properties.name: The Z Hotel Covent Garden

properties.name: The Z Hotel Trafalgar
properties.branch: Named as Trafalgar by all six (Full Suitcase 'The Z Hotel Trafalgar', r/TravelHacks 'Z Hotel Trafalgar').

properties.name: Good Hotel London
properties.branch: One property: the floating hotel at Royal Victoria Dock. Trading confirmed 14 Sep 2026 (consensus tradingConfirmed).

properties.name: The Hoxton, Shepherd's Bush
properties.branch: Named as Shepherd's Bush by all five. Not The Hoxton Holborn (its own entry below), Shoreditch or Southwark.

properties.name: Church Street Hotel

properties.name: Premier Inn London Kensington (Earl's Court)
properties.branch: 11 Knaresborough Place, SW5 0TJ. Mumsnet's 'Premier Inn Kensington (Earls Court)', London Toolkit's 'Premier Inn Kensington (Earl's Court)', Globetotting 'next to Earls Court station', Cheap Family Holidays links london-kensington-earls-court.

properties.name: ibis Styles London Southwark
properties.branch: Hotels.com: 'ibis Styles London Southwark - near Borough Market'. Wheatless Wanderlust 'the Ibis Styles on Southwark bridge', Mumsnet 'Ibis Styles near Borough Market'. Not ibis Styles Gloucester Road or Ealing.

properties.name: The Z Hotel Victoria
properties.branch: Named as Victoria by all five (Steffen 'Das Z Hotel Victoria', The Holiday Lab 'Z Hotel Victoria').

properties.name: The Lime Tree Hotel
properties.branch: One property: 135-137 Ebury Street, Belgravia, SW1W 9QU. Hotels.com lists it as 'Room Mate Lime Tree', the operator branding The Independent uses (consensus renamed).
properties.statusNote: No one-night stay for 2 adults could be booked on any of the five sample nights, on either channel (14 Sep 2026). Hotels.com: 'can't accommodate 2 guests' on 11 and 17 Oct, 'no rooms available at this property' on 17 Feb, 12 Dec and 17 Apr (captures kept in budget-2026-09-14.json). The operator's own SynXis engine (bookings.limetreehotel.co.uk, titled 'Room Mate Lime Tree - Reservations'): 'check-in/check-out combination is not available' for 11 Oct, 17 Feb and 12 Dec; 'cannot accept departures' on the Sunday after 17 Oct and 17 Apr, i.e. no one-night Saturday stays. For scale only, not a sampled night: the room-matehotels.com calendar showed from-prices of £241-£375 for other October 2026 nights (1, 3, 4, 5, 6 and 12 Oct).

properties.name: The Culpeper
properties.branch: One property: the pub with rooms at 40 Commercial Street, Spitalfields, E1 1DU. Priced on its own Mews engine, the one theculpeper.com links to: Hotels.com lists it (ho1088560416) but showed 'no rooms available at this property for your trip dates' on all five sample nights on 14 Sep 2026.

properties.name: The Hoxton, Holborn
properties.branch: Named as Holborn by all four. 199-206 High Holborn, WC1V 7BD.

properties.name: Moxy London Stratford
properties.branch: Named as Stratford by all four. Not Moxy London ExCeL, which has its own record.

properties.name: hub by Premier Inn London King's Cross
properties.match: hub by Premier Inn London King's Cross
properties.branch: 50 Wharfdale Road, N1 9FA - the only hub at King's Cross in Premier Inn's London directory. Mumsnet 'the hub at Kings Cross' and 'Premier Inn Hub Kings X', r/TravelHacks 'hub by premier inn... near kings cross/st. Pancras'. Not Premier Inn London King's Cross (26-30 York Way), its own entry below.

properties.name: St. Athans Hotel
properties.branch: One property: 20-24 Tavistock Place, Bloomsbury, WC1H 9RE (EuroCheapo 'Bloomsbury', London Toolkit 'Russell Square', r/uktravel links stathanshotel.com).
properties.pricingNote: Hotels.com priced only Sun 11 Oct; its 'can't accommodate 2 guests' / 'no rooms' on the other four nights matches the hotel's own Hoteliga engine (book.hoteliga.com/stathanshotel, 14 Sep 2026): doubles and twins sold out on Sat 17 Oct and a two-night minimum on Sat 17 Oct and Sat 12 Dec (on 12 Dec a shared-bathroom double shows at £102.58 a night non-refundable, but only for stays of two nights or more), and bookings not yet open ('results/closed') for 17 Feb and 17 Apr. So no engine sells a one-night double on those nights.

properties.name: The Resident Victoria

properties.name: W12 Rooms
properties.branch: One property, Shepherd's Bush (Steffen 'W12 Rooms London - Shepherds Bush').

properties.branch: 34 Park Street, Bankside, SE1 9EF. properties.name: Premier Inn London King's Cross
